description: This conceptual map illustrates the spatial distribution and classification of various land cover types within an estuarine system according to the CORINE Land Cover (CLC) nomenclature. The map depicts a river flowing into the sea. Light blue areas represent water bodies, and light yellow/beige areas represent land. The dark blue area on the far left represents 8.4.2.0 Coastal waters. Adjacent to the coastal waters, the light yellow/beige land area is labelled 6.2.1 Beaches. The main, wider light blue channel at the river mouth is classified as 8.3.2.0 Estuaries. Within these estuaries, small green patches are identified as 7.2.1.0 Salt marshes. Further inland, the narrower light blue river sections are labelled 8.1.1.0 Natural/Semi-natural water courses. The surrounding landmass is consistently represented by a light yellow/beige colour. No scale bar, compass orientation, or specific geographic location is indicated; the map serves as a generic example of an estuarine environment's CLC classification.
